# Mahdi Sarikhanifard — Self-Service Kiosk & Interactive Device Developer

> Portfolio of Mahdi Sarikhanifard, a software engineering student and developer in Brisbane, Australia, building Flutter applications, white-label self-service kiosks and interactive device experiences.

## About

- Name: Mahdi Sarikhanifard (Amir Mahdi Sarikhanifard)
- Role: Software engineering student and developer
- Location: Brisbane, Queensland, Australia
- Study: Bachelor of Cyber Security, Griffith University
- Availability: Open to junior software engineering roles and internships
- Focus: Flutter, Dart, React, TypeScript, application state, self-service kiosks, interactive devices, merchant tools and reporting

## Project

- Name: White-Label Self-Service Kiosk
- Description: A tablet-style, self-service ordering kiosk with a merchant back office. Customers browse a menu, customise items and pay at the counter or through a simulated QR checkout.
- Stack: Flutter, Dart, Riverpod, go_router, freezed, Shelf, fl_chart
- Includes: customer ordering, item options, cart, QR payment simulation, branding and typography, menu templates, menu management, kitchen display, analytics and CSV/PDF export
- Status: Portfolio prototype. Payments and menu scanning are simulated; merchant data is sample or in-memory data.
- Source: https://github.com/tabseen/White-labeled-self-service-kiosk-for-Ipad
